title: Forced-choice reports can capture too little or too much

statements.text: Forced-choice reports sometimes miss what is seen and sometimes capture more than is seen, as in blindsight, so a capacity difference between early vision and report needs no separate system for phenomenology. Metacognitive measures, subjective reports collected beside forced-choice responses, are needed.

sources.quote: While phenomenology may overflow forced-choice reports, the later can also overestimate the former, as in the case of blindsight.
We have been doing just this by employing metacognitive measures
